items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Never heard talk of him, eh? I heard of him.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Peter must have had a good son. Remember Lory Warnick? No, I didn't know him.
Never heard talk of him, eh? I heard of him. Yeah, but he, he played with the Quill Seller neighbors, you know, Lory Warnick there.
Well, how big a band would Peter have then? Uh. How big a band would Peter have? Would he have five men or ten men?
